g.title:
9. Non Self-Hosted Enterprise Applications (SaaS) [Enterprise SaaS Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Consolidates 14 specialized third-party hosted software-as-a-service (SaaS) and managed security solutions, including Microsoft 365, Bloomberg Professional, Refinitiv (FIFX), Diligent BoardEffect, Zoho ATS, Kahoot!, Adroit Iconcept 4, QualysGuard, Portnox CLEAR, Prisma Cloud, CyberSOC Africa, Ultracrest, and SWIFT.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Empowers executive governance, treasury capital markets dealing, enterprise risk, corporate office productivity, staff talent learning, and 24/7 managed cyber defense without on-premises hardware overhead.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Head Office & Branch Users via Forcepoint SWG (HTTPS 443), Treasury Dealing Desks via Dedicated Leased Circuits (Ports 8194 & 443), Primary DC & Cloud Telemetry via Mutual TLS (Ports 443 & 6514) • OUTBOUND: Primary DC Calypso Treasury via B-PIPE feed, Corporate Ingress via Entra ID SAML 2.0 Identity Federation • FAILOVER: Provider-managed global multi-region SaaS redundancy, redundant leased circuits for treasury data feeds, and local caching on endpoints. • SECURITY: Microsoft Entra ID SAML 2.0 SSO, Forcepoint CASB/DLP policy enforcement, Delinea PAM privileged access monitoring, and air-gapped dedicated hosting. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
